card.name: Inside drug and protein names
card.fires_on: The short ending piece in the middle of a longer name, such as the 'os' in Aminosyn or prazosin, or the 'in' in interleukin before a hyphen and number. It also fires on a few other partway-through word pieces.

modes.label: Interleukin before number
modes.description: The 'in' ending of interleukin just before a hyphen and a number like -1, -2 or -6.

modes.label: Drug brand or generic name
modes.description: The 'os' piece inside Aminosyn or prazosin.

modes.label: Other word pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a rarer word such as woollens or Babylonian.
